stories.title: Arrest warrants for Sohail Afridi, others out in Radio Pakistan attack case
stories.brief: PESHAWAR: An anti-terrorism court on Wednesday issued arrest warrants for Sohail Afridi, the ex-chief minister who was rendered nonfunctional after the imposition of governor’s rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and four other PTI leaders in the Radio Pakistan attack case.

stories.title: ATC issues Sohail Afridi's arrest warrants
stories.brief: Defence counsel Ali Zaman Advocate appeared for the nominated accused, while investigating officer Khushhal, the public prosecutor and Radio Pakistan counsel Shabbir Hussain Ghaigiani were also present.

stories.title: Elon Musk is a 'real genius', Putin says after satellite talks with SpaceX boss
stories.brief: The Russian President praised Musk and said they are in "close" contact.

stories.title: PM orders urgent reforms in Islamabad government schools
stories.brief: According to a press release issued by the Prime Minister’s Office, he said teachers in government schools should focus exclusively on teaching and should not be assigned activities unrelated to education.

stories.title: 2,410 terrorists killed in last nine months
stories.brief: According to the ministry, the companies complied with 23.7% of requests made by the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) and 47% of those submitted by the Counter Terrorism Department (CTD). The ministry said social media companies had yet to adopt government rules, leaving gaps in the regulatory framework.

stories.title: Pakistan, Qatar close to revised LNG deal
stories.brief: Sources in PSO told The Express Tribune that Pakistan requested that QatarEnergy lower its LNG prices from 13.37% to 10.20% of Brent under the pricing formula for their first LNG contract. Pakistan-designated entity Pakistan State Oil (PSO) and Qatargas have serviced LNG supply contract review notices.

stories.title: Fazl calls for new Charter of Democracy
stories.brief: "I invite you to sit at one table and establish a new Charter of Democracy," he said, adding that the proposed agreement should bring both the government and opposition together to protect the country from unconstitutional actions and violence.

stories.title: Pakistan brings regional rivals together
stories.brief: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye... will have to work together," a senior diplomat had told The Express Tribune several months ago, when discussions about what eventually became the Makkah defence arrangement were still in their infancy.

stories.title: FCC flags SC move on settled case
stories.brief: The Federal Constitutional Court (FCC) on Wednesday expressed serious reservations over the Supreme Court bench's handling of a matter that had already been decided, saying the approach raised concerns about judicial discipline, legal norms and institutional propriety.

stories.title: ECP excludes 12 K-P districts from local government polls
stories.brief: The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) on Wednesday ordered local government (LG) elections to be held immediately in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) districts where delimitation has been completed, excluding areas covered by special emergency measures. The commission directed its relevant wing to submit the election programme for approval in districts where the delimitation process has been completed.

stories.title: PM links progress to digitalisation, AI
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Wednesday directed relevant ministries to complete, by November, all necessary measures for projects being undertaken with Alibaba Group to advance artificial intelligence, digitalisation, exports and public service delivery.

stories.title: Microsoft profits soar days after announcing thousands of layoffs
stories.brief: The week, the Windows developer said it would offer buyouts to 60,000 workers as it looks to curb costs.

stories.title: I earn £30,000. I'm angry there was no fuel duty cut in the Budget
stories.brief: People on a range of incomes from £4,062 to £150,000 a year tell the BBC what they made of this year's Budget.

stories.title: Building boom puts 300,000 people in the path of potential Himalayan disasters
stories.brief: The construction of tourism facilities, housing, and infrastructure has surged in parts of Nepal and India's Uttarakhand.

stories.title: Three ways the Budget affects you

stories.brief: AI has made some awesome scientific discoveries. But now, questions are being raised about its accuracy

stories.title: 'An annoying buzz': The search for stealthier drones
stories.brief: As drone deliveries become more commonplace, their makers are looking for ways to make them quieter.

stories.title: At least 5 killed, over two dozen injured as bus plunges into drain in Punjab's Hafizabad
stories.brief: LAHORE: At least five people were killed and 27 others injured when a passenger bus plunged into a drain in Punjab’s Hafizabad district on Thursday, according to Rescue 1122. Five rescue vehicles participated in the operation, Rescue 1122 said.

stories.title: Inquiry holds school owner responsible for roof collapse
stories.brief: PESHAWAR: An inquiry into the recent deadly collapse of a school roof here has held the owner responsible for using substandard construction material. On Wednesday, the inquiry committee held the school owner responsible for using substandard construction material.
